description.en: Reasonix-style cache-aware compaction backend for the ctx.compaction seam: a single compact_ratio trigger, one structured summary checkpoint over a stable prefix and recent tail, and a canonical transcript that normal compaction never rewrites.
description.zh: Reasonix 风格缓存感知压缩后端，实现 ctx.compaction seam：唯一 compact_ratio 触发；稳定前缀 + 一条结构化 summary + recent tail 组成检查点；常规压缩永不改写 canonical transcript。
